composition.rule: Decode exact P1345 FINAL by its declared R1-then-R2 composition. Preserve its full canonical source, normalization, nineteen-row runtime, compiler, probe primitive, classification, mutation, forbidden-binding and scope semantics. Replace only CLI preflight, authority/delivery roots and probe byte execution with this binding. Counts remain exactly twelve files, 38 capsules, 2,506 canonical tokens, nineteen runtime rows and one opaque probe.

cli_preflight_binding.mode: focal invocation requires --focus; full invocation mode is available only to the independent preseal/final wrapper and is outside oracle/adversary authority
pre_argparse_order: SCHEMA: reject NUL/non-UTF-8 or an option lacking its required following value without reading any authority artifact.
DUPLICATE_KEY: reject a recognized option occurring more than its declared maximum.
SCHEMA: reject case variants, prefix abbreviations, --name=value, combined flags, unknown options, positional tokens and value spill; no argparse-generated diagnostic is accepted.

AUTHORITY_ROOT: authenticate every presented corpus/receipt path, digest, expected checker digest and expected authoring root against the canonical lexical path, no-symlink root, rehashed bytes and causal pins, even if another required option is absent.
SCHEMA: reject absent required options or absent --focus in focal mode only after all presented authority values pass.
ARGPARSE_CONFIRMATION: parse the preflight-approved vector with allow_abbrev=false, no defaults and no environment expansion; require exact equality with the manual projection before dispatch.
cli_preflight_binding.authority_priority: P1344-A21 and P1344-R2A17 alternate corpus/path/digest/root presentations are AUTHORITY_ROOT before completeness. Their required stdout is empty, stderr is exactly one closed AUTHORITY_ROOT line plus LF, exit is 2 and no artifact is parsed or executable loaded.
cli_preflight_binding.path_identity: The accepted argument is the exact repository-relative canonical_paths string. Reject absolute equivalents, ./, ../, repeated separators, case variants and any symlink in an ancestor or leaf. Open beneath the verifier-selected real authority root without following symlinks, require a regular file and hash the bytes used.
cli_preflight_binding.digest_identity: Every supplied digest is exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal and must equal both its causal predecessor pin and the independently recomputed whole-file hash. A supplied digest never creates authority.

artifact_schemas.caller_source: p1346-oracle-caller-r1.py is source bytes, not JSON. Its immutable literals are checker path/hash, authorship-receipt path/hash and authoring_root_sha256. It strict-validates the complete authorship receipt before loading checker and accepts only FOCAL_AUTHORED_NOT_VERIFIED_NOT_SEALED.
artifact_schemas.p1345_artifacts: Every unlisted positive-fixture, canonical-table, corpus-case, source-result, runtime-receipt and primitive semantic schema is exactly the composed P1345 FINAL binding.

schema_semantics.strict: Reject duplicate decoded keys at any depth, unknown/missing/reordered keys, unknown enum, wrong type/cardinality, non-finite number, invalid UTF-8 and invalid canonical path/hash before field use. Legacy protected P1345 artifacts are accepted only as the exact pinned bytes; new P1346 oracle/verifier JSON outputs use the schemas here.
schema_semantics.canonical_outputs: Every newly authored P1346 corpus, authority receipt, delivery receipt, checker result and verifier report is RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 followed by exactly one LF; therefore every declared key list for those artifacts is lexicographically sorted by the RFC 8785 property order. Whole-file hashes include that LF. Equivalent parsed values encoded with alternate key order, escapes, number spelling or trailing bytes are noncanonical and Violated. Exact protected P1345 fixture/table bytes and exact P1345 R2 probe request/output wire records are strict pinned legacy inputs and retain their declared non-JCS field order.
nullable_fields: runtime_receipt_sha256 outside candidate/final and runtime-bearing discriminatory cases
probe_executable_sha256, probe_memfd_sha256 and probe_output_sha256 outside the sole opaque case
schema_semantics.no_answer: Corpus, candidate, probe, authorship receipt, caller and delivery receipt contain no expected/classification/reason/witness field. Only checker_result contains a derived classification after all earlier gates.
schema_semantics.no_self_digest: No JSON artifact contains an expected digest for itself. A hash field that describes captured child output or memfd bytes is not a self-file digest and is accepted only where explicitly declared.

authority_root_contract.rfc8785_array: Each root hashes the exact RFC 8785 serialization of the displayed ordered JSON array, with no trailing LF inside the hash preimage. Every component is a 64-lowercase-hex whole-file/content digest except literal domain and invocation_kind and nullable invocation evidence explicitly stated.
authority_root_contract.authoring_root_formula: authoring_root_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1346-authoring-root-r1", step_sha256, authority_manifest_sha256, l0_toolchain_freeze_sha256, capsule_baseline_sha256, topology_receipt_sha256, probe_relocation_receipt_sha256, p1345_final_contract_spec_sha256, p1345_final_contract_binding_sha256, p1345_final_contract_receipt_sha256, p1346_contract_spec_sha256, p1346_contract_binding_sha256, positive_fixture_sha256, canonical_table_sha256, source_verifier_sha256, probe_source_sha256, corpus_sha256, checker_sha256])).
authority_root_contract.execution_root_formula: execution_root_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1346-execution-root-r1", delivery_root_sha256, invocation_kind, probe_executable_sha256_or_null, probe_memfd_sha256_or_null, fresh_challenge_hex_or_null, invocation_nonce_hex_or_null, process_nonce_hex_or_null, probe_output_sha256_or_null, seen_value_registry_sha256, runtime_receipt_sha256_or_null])).
authority_root_contract.external_anchor: Preseal/final receives expected delivery_receipt_sha256 out of band. It rehashes that exact file before parse, recomputes delivery root, validates exact consumes/must-not-consume sets and walks to all authoring-root components before importing caller/checker.
authority_root_contract.fail_closed: Unavailable component, failed receipt, hash/schema/path/root mismatch, cyclic edge, reverse dependency, self-digest, caller/receipt verdict disagreement, alternate coordinated set or missing external delivery digest is AUTHORITY_ROOT and Violated before case execution.

exact_order: consume protected positive fixture, canonical table, source verifier and relocated probe source without rewriting them
emit p1346-oracle-checker-r1.py with literal protected/corpus/contract pins and root formulas
compute authoring_root_sha256 from final checker bytes
emit p1346-oracle-authorship-receipt-r1.json pinning checker and authoring root, self-excluding
emit p1346-oracle-caller-r1.py pinning checker, authorship receipt and authoring root
compute delivery_root_sha256 from final caller bytes
deliver the delivery-receipt whole-file SHA-256 out of band to adversary/preseal
artifact_authoring_order.causal_rule: An artifact may consume only earlier items. Modifying any earlier byte invalidates every downstream item. Authorship and delivery receipts may be failure diagnostics outside a seal only when their closed schema/verdict explicitly says failure; a failed receipt cannot be passed as the green causal input.
artifact_authoring_order.import_rule: No Python checker/caller module is imported or executed until the external delivery digest and complete backward hash walk pass.

probe_build_memfd_binding.build_environment: Verifier-owned minimal inherited environment with network unavailable; no RUSTFLAGS, wrapper, linker override, candidate environment or source-path inference. Output is a fresh regular file in a verifier-owned /dev/shm directory.

memfd_create.name: p1346-opaque-probe
memfd_create.descriptor_rule: fresh anonymous descriptor, explicitly inherited only by the child; no preexisting or candidate descriptor

probe_build_memfd_binding.copy_rule: Read the no-symlink build output once, require its externally rooted SHA-256, write all bytes to memfd, set executable mode, rewind, compare exact length and SHA-256, apply and verify all required seals, then execute only execution_path.
probe_build_memfd_binding.post_rule: Keep descriptor open through child exit; require output from that PID/pipe, then rehash memfd and require equality with pre-execution memfd and build-output hashes before closing.
probe_build_memfd_binding.request_and_output: Use exact P1345 FINAL R2 three-key request and nine-key primitive output, formulas and freshness registry. memfd metadata is verifier evidence and cannot be emitted by the probe as trust input.
probe_build_memfd_binding.failure: No memfd, no /proc, seal/mode/copy/hash/length/PID/emitter mismatch, timeout, path race or unavailable primitive is PROBE_AUTHORITY/Violated. No fallback is permitted.

p1345_final_binding.capsule_ids_and_paths: Exact ordered 38 capsule_ids and twelve file_paths from the protected P1345 binding/table; no addition, deletion or reorder.
p1345_final_binding.token_and_normalization: Exact canonical token table at ffe9322a..., fixture at 8cf40781..., source verifier at 9434ca3f..., 2,506 tokens and 12/12 inverse normalization.
p1345_final_binding.runtime: Exact nineteen protected rows/hook bindings and real A/B receipt requirements, with carrier, ledger, facade, identities, freshness, causal and cardinality semantics unchanged.
p1345_final_binding.primitive: Exact P1345 R2 request/output schemas, domain separator 50313334352d4f50415155452d50524f42452d4348414c4c454e47452d563100, process_nonce_hex disclosure and independent process/challenge/invocation digest formulas.
p1345_final_binding.gates: Exact distinct source, rustfmt, observation Cargo --no-run, normal Cargo build, real runtime and opacity gates.

classification.preserved: Inspectable input passes every applicable protected/source/compiler/runtime predicate and the transport chain is authentic.
classification.violated: The first failed predicate, including every CLI/DAG/canonical-delivery/memfd failure, valid semantic mutation, missing runtime or supplied answer channel.
classification.unknown: Only the checker-derived classification for the single executed fresh opaque probe after all authority/source/compiler/runtime/transport/hash/freshness predicates pass.
classification.unknown_never_default: Unsupported parser input, ambiguous identity, absent proof, budget exhaustion, missing memfd/seals, failed receipt or transport error is Violated, never Unknown.

P1344-A21-alternate-corpus-and-digest.required_precedence: Alternate presented corpus identity is checked before omitted-required completeness.

P1344-R2A17-alternate-corpus-root.required_precedence: Lexical/no-symlink corpus root and external authoring-root mismatch are checked before omitted-required completeness.

mutation_and_gate_binding.negative_set: All 122 P1345 valid negatives plus P1346 closed-CLI, alternate-root/digest, receipt-cycle/failure, caller swap, delivery-pin, external-anchor, duplicate/canonical-JSON, memfd/seal/path/symlink/swap/restore/emitter/replay mutations. At least one valid mutation per each of 38 capsules and all forty P1344 attacks remain included.
mutation_and_gate_binding.score: valid semantic negatives classified Violated divided by all valid semantic negatives; exactly 1.0 in focal before preseal and in each complete normal/repeat/reverse order.
mutation_and_gate_binding.controls: All eight final P1345 controls plus P1346 boundary controls pass with no regression; sole authenticated opaque case is Unknown and excluded from mutation denominator.
mutation_and_gate_binding.full_budget: Contract/oracle/adversary full runs are zero; independent preseal has exactly one normal/repeat/reverse full and final verifier exactly one.
mutation_and_gate_binding.seal: A survivor, non-1.0 score, external-anchor failure, protected drift or regression prevents seal and therefore prevents RED/candidate.

forbidden_bindings: Every forbidden P1345/P1344/P1343/P1342 binding at its protected hash.
Calling argparse before manual authority preflight or accepting its missing-required diagnostic over a presented authority mismatch.
Option abbreviation, alias, default, environment expansion, CLI digest override, duplicate last-wins parsing or noncanonical path.
Authorship receipt consuming/pinning caller or delivery receipt; caller consuming delivery receipt; delivery receipt or any artifact self-pinning.
Preseal/final obtaining expected delivery-receipt digest from the delivery chain, repository sibling, candidate, checker or corpus instead of out of band.
Executing the build-output pathname, a tempfile, unsealed memfd, candidate descriptor or any fallback; omitting any required seal or pre/post hash.
Renaming/re-emitting probe source as .rs under diagnostics, changing its bytes, changing crystalline-lint to ignore it or inferring crate name from .rs.txt.
Unknown on transport failure, missing candidate runtime, absent memfd, unsupported grammar, ambiguous identity or exhausted budget.
A thirteenth consumer, non-local owner, reverse import/reexport, wrapper/trait/macro/container, L0/public/default/pipeline/compatibility change or weakened inherited semantic negative.

budget.stop: Any valid survivor, score below 1.0, same vector/cause twice, protected drift, missing external trust anchor, cyclic delivery, unsealed/path execution, lint failure, ADR-0127 trigger, positive regression, weakened negative or exhausted budget blocks the causal chain.

closed_metadata.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order are valid. All CLI tokens/arities, JSON keys/orders/types, DAG consumes sets, root domains/order, build/memfd rules, classifications and P1345 FINAL obligations are closed. Duplicate/unknown keys, alternate ordering/formula/schema, semantic weakening or scope expansion is Violated.
